title: Findings Report (devteam report --findings)
description: Severity-ordered findings collected from every review artifact present: security-review (stage-04b), red-team including the 31.2 mechanical floor (stage-04c), peer-review + critic (stage-05 / stage-05.critic), the 31.4 mutation smoke gate (stage-06), verification-beyond-tests (stage-06d), and docs/audit/*.md when the audit workflow has run. Phase 35 item 35.4. core/report/collect-findings.js is the authoritative reader; this file documents the same contract.

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the report was generated.

sourcesScanned.description: One entry per review artifact type this collector knows how to read, regardless of whether it was present in this pipeline — lets a reader distinguish 'ran and found nothing' from 'never ran'.

findings.description: Severity-ordered (critical→low→unknown), ties broken orchestrator-observed-first, then source, then id. Empty array is a valid, honest 'nothing found' result — never rendered as an error.

id.description: Stable id from the originating artifact (e.g. 'RT-3', 'MUT-1', 'S-1'), null when the source had none.

mitigation.description: Suggested fix, when the source artifact stated one.

effort.description: Rough effort as stated by the source (e.g. 'XS'/'S'/'M'/'L'), not a computed estimate.

provenance.description: orchestrator-observed: traces to code the orchestrator itself ran (mechanical red-team floor, mutation gate, a confirmed stage-06d stamp, an approval-derivation-hook-derived peer-review mismatch). model-asserted: a model's judgment, even when well-evidenced in prose.

sourceFile.description: Path to the artifact this finding was read from.
